t: 教宗利奥二世被选为天主教会会长,虽然直到8月17日他才被封为神.
te: Pope Leo II is elected head of the Catholic Church, although he will not be consecrated until 17 August.
dz: 教宗利奥二世被选为天主教会会长,虽然直到8月17日他才被封为神.
de: Pope Leo II is elected head of the Catholic Church, although he will not be consecrated until 17 August.

t: 教宗佩拉吉斯一世得到皇帝查士丁尼一世的皇帝批准后被封为皇帝.
te: Pope Pelagius I is consecrated following Imperial approval by Emperor Justinian I.
dz: 教宗佩拉吉斯一世得到皇帝查士丁尼一世的皇帝批准后被封为皇帝.
de: Pope Pelagius I is consecrated following Imperial approval by Emperor Justinian I.

t: 马萨达是一座犹太堡垒，经过几个月的围困后落入罗马人之手，结束了第一次犹太罗马战争。
te: Masada, a Jewish fortress, falls to the Romans after several months of siege, ending the First Jewish–Roman War.
dz: 马萨达是一座犹太堡垒，经过几个月的围困后落入罗马人之手，结束了第一次犹太罗马战争。
de: Masada, a Jewish fortress, falls to the Romans after several months of siege, ending the First Jewish–Roman War.

t: 被维特利乌斯在贝德里亚库姆出兵所败,罗马皇帝奥托自杀.
te: Defeated by Vitellius' troops at Bedriacum, Roman emperor Otho commits suicide.
dz: 被维特利乌斯在贝德里亚库姆出兵所败,罗马皇帝奥托自杀.
de: Defeated by Vitellius' troops at Bedriacum, Roman emperor Otho commits suicide.

t: 第一次战斗被记录在被接受为相对可靠的细节中.
te: The first battle to have been recorded in what is accepted as relatively reliable detail.
dz: 梅吉多之战: 第一次战斗被记录在被接受为相对可靠的细节中.
de: Battle of Megiddo: The first battle to have been recorded in what is accepted as relatively reliable detail.
